title.narrative: Government Actuary Department (GAD) Reporting, Advice and review of ARC

description.narrative: FCDO hold a letter of engagement with Governments Actuaries Department for technical actuarial work for the African Risk Capacity Programme. GAD review ARC Ltd.’s quarterly reports, provide an annual loan evaluation and are available to commission on an ad hoc basis for work that is deemed valuable for the programme, on the provision of an agreed terms of reference and budget. GAD allow FCDO greater oversight and technical understanding of ARC Ltd activities. They help FCDO challenge and shape ARC’s risk profiling, dynamic financial analysis, capitalisation, underwriting and accounting/valuation policies for example’
